identity: Neotoma selected identity: symbol 'Retained sheets', wordmark N2 (Newsreader 600, licensed outlines)
decision: The operator selected this Neotoma identity on 2026-10-06.

neotoma-lockup-drafting.svg.method: path data and transforms copied unchanged; solid fill replaced by a 1px non-scaling outline stroke; nothing redrawn

note: n2-nav-light.svg is the same file (same sha256) recorded as the accepted Neotoma lockup in the Constara preview asset provenance.

plate.identity: Sheet 01 plate (FIG. A-1), round 2: a generated illustration of paper objects (not a photograph), derived from the accepted earlier-site hero photograph, shown under inline SVG drafting callouts (keys 1 to 5)

hero.accepted_as: hero image of the earlier Neotoma site; declared with this sha256 as the neotoma brand photograph in og-photo-inventory.mjs, as N-hero in tension-trace-r2-art.json, and in provenance/source-import.json of that repository. The live public review build serves the identical bytes (checked 2026-10-20 against https://markmhendrickson.github.io/sites/neotoma/images/tension-trace-r2/N-hero.jpg).
hero.role: material reference input to both generations (paper stock, grain, ground, light and shadow); not altered, not shipped

generation.tool: Recraft image_edit (external model nano_banana_pro); no custom style, which that tool does not take

wide.note: vector render of the objects in frontend/src/components/onepager/plate_layout.ts (PLATE_WIDE_LAYOUT), no callouts

narrow.note: vector render of the objects in PLATE_NARROW_LAYOUT, no callouts

generation.prompt_summary: turn image 1 into a real overhead photograph of cut paper and card matching image 2 (the hero) in material, colour, grain, matte beige ground, light from the upper left and soft shadows; keep every object and printed mark at the same position, size and silhouette; the sheet's corner clipped and folded back; a short shallow crease near the light card's top edge stopping well short of both corners; three slots punched through the square card, one per row; add, move or remove nothing; no text, letters, numbers, logos, icons, symbols, stamps, paperclips, hands or people

narrow.verdict: rejected as generated: the email lost its address block and the sheet's corner became a page curl; repaired by the object transplant below

credits.note: exploration total includes round 1 (46 credits: three rejected image_to_image tries with a private style made from the hero, two image_edit frames later superseded)

preparation.registration: each output resampled to its layout frame and offset by edge correlation against the structure render: wide scale 0.995 x 1.000, offset (4, 0) px; narrow scale 1.000 x 0.995, offset (0, 2) px; edge-replicate padding; no other change
preparation.transplant: narrow frame only: the PDF and email objects (with their shadows) cut from the registered wide frame, scaled to the PLATE_NARROW_LAYOUT boxes (0.892 x 0.882 and 1.111 x 1.105), ground tone matched on an 8 px ring, edges feathered over 14 px; nothing painted
preparation.held: the raw outputs, inputs and prepared frames are kept with the operator's exploration record, not in this repository

layout.method: sha256 of JSON.stringify({ width, height, objects }) for each frame; the images were generated and registered against exactly these boxes, so a changed box needs new images

derivation.method: decode each prepared frame and re-encode as WebP q88 and, as the fallback for browsers without WebP (Safari before 14), progressive JPEG q70; no metadata is written to either. The script refuses a frame whose sha256 is not the recorded one. The callouts are inline SVG in the page (onepager_plate.tsx), not in these files.

plate/neotoma-plate-a1-r2-wide.jpg.use: desktop plate, fallback for browsers without WebP

plate/neotoma-plate-a1-r2-narrow.jpg.use: phone plate, fallback for browsers without WebP

plate.superseded: round 1 plate files (neotoma-plate-a1-{wide,narrow}.{webp,jpg}, re-encodes of the hero photograph itself) were superseded before merge and never shipped
